append_update.caveat: changes only the post's text; Mastodon's edit endpoint cannot change a status's visibility or its media once posted.

draft.reason: Mastodon posts a status live the moment it is created; the API has no unpublished form of one to hold before that (its separate scheduled-post feature is not covered by the spec this wrapper was written against).

list_owned.caveat: returns the most recent page of the account's own posts, newest first, boosts excluded.

publish.caveat: only When.Mode "now" is offered; Mastodon's scheduled posts are not covered by the spec this wrapper was written against, so "at" and "announce" are refused.

read_back.caveat: the text is read back with the link publish appended to it (since Mastodon has no separate field for one) taken back off when it matches; the link is the post's preview card URL if Mastodon found one, and the media description is the first attachment's, both approximations rather than what was originally given.

read_series.reason: Mastodon's API reports an account's or a post's counts as they stand now; it offers no time-windowed analytics to bucket by granularity.

read_total.reason: Mastodon's API reports an account's or a post's counts as they stand now, not a total over a window; read a post's counts with read_metrics instead.

search.reason: this wrapper acts on one account's own posts; it does not search Mastodon's federated content on the account's behalf.

set_cap.reason: Mastodon exposes nothing this wrapper could set a numeric cap on.

manifest.idempotency: native for publish only, via the Idempotency-Key header, kept for up to one hour (methods/statuses#create); append_update, retract and the rest have none.
manifest.storage_policy: this instance's terms of service (https://mastodon.social/terms-of-service, read from GET /api/v2/instance) govern what may be kept of content posted there; Mendel keeps only the reference (the post's id and URL) to what it wrote, not a copy of anyone else's posts.

authorization.expires: never by default: Mastodon access tokens obtained this way do not expire unless a person or the instance's admin revokes them (no refresh grant is offered).

shape.description: One post on a social platform or community site, complete and as it will appear.

text.description: The post, complete and ready to paste. Under 280 characters where the platform limits length, and never over 1,000. Say the one thing worth saying; no hashtags unless the platform expects them.

link.description: The link the post carries, copied exactly as given, or null when the post carries none.

media.description: A one-sentence description of an image or short video to attach, or null for none. Mendel does not produce media; the person attaches it.
